name: Sweet Potato "Avocado Toast" with Soft-boiled Eggs

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil and position rack in the middle of the oven.
Place eggs in a large pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg sweet potatoes
3 avocados
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard ends of sweet potatoes; peel and slice lengthwise into ½-inch thick pieces. Discard any small, outer slices, then place remaining slices on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil.
Rub the oil over both sides of the sweet potato slices, then season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place sweet potatoes in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, 8-10 minutes, or until tender. (Keep a close watch on the sweet potatoes to avoid burning.)
Halve and pit the avocados, then scoop out into a medium bowl.
Grate zest from the lemons and set aside, then juice lemons into the bowl with the avocado. Add salt and garlic powder and mash with a potato masher or fork; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: To serve, spread a spoonful of avocado mash over each slice of sweet potato; top with eggs, lemon zest, chili powder, and salt. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp chili powder
⅜ tsp salt
